name: Coastal Habitat Aquarium V06
description: Coastal Habitat Aquarium, increment 6 of 7 (about 2000 objects). An organic, modelled habitat tank: curved outline and leaning walls, sculpted rockwork, a three-level floor with a cavern under the shelf, bridges over and tunnels through, kelp forest and reef. Tap an animal to read about it. Sizes are estimates, in inches.
